name: fire-smoke-skill-vfx
description: Build the effects of a fire skill as one visual language in Three.js. Flames that read as fire, not as orange fog or cones: ray-marched flame volumes whose turbulence rises with buoyancy (slow at the root, accelerating and stretching as it climbs) instead of scrolling, a temperature ramp from a white-hot core a little above the fuel through yellow and orange to deep red tips, broad brighter licks inside, walls of fire broken into clumps of separate tongues of very different heights with notches
author: MengTo
